title: Storage Weeks Charged on Lapsed Tire Orders — Tire Sets & Treadwear Limited Warranty
content:
Storage on a lapsed Tire Sets & Treadwear Limited Warranty order is charged at $2.00 per tire a week, and the number of weeks follows how long the order sat past its hold (the calendar days from the purchase date plus the line's hold after purchase, to today):

| Days past hold | Weeks charged |
|---|---|
| 1 to 6 | one week, however few days the order sat |
| more than 28 | a flat three weeks, however long the order sat |
| any other (7 to 28, or none) | every whole week past hold |

**Both sides (hypothetical 4-tire order):** 6 days past hold — $8.00; 7 days — one whole week, $8.00; 13 days — $8.00; 14 days — $16.00; 28 days — $32.00; 29 days — three weeks, $24.00; 60 days — $24.00.
